newsitem.title: USA: American Electric in talks with Wabash.
newsitem.headline: American Electric in talks with Wabash.

text.p: American Electric Power Co Inc said Wednesday it opened talks with Wabash Valley Power Association to explore various options, including the acquisition of its assets.

Wabash Valley Power Association is a not-for-profit electric utility owned by 25 rural electric membership coporations in Indiana and Michigan. American Electric said any offer would not attempt to affect the structure, governance or integrity of those corporations.
American Electric declined to comment further on the nature of the discussions.
